title: I can't hear any sound
summary: No sound from videos, class apps, or your Chromebook's speakers.

steps.title: Turn up the volume
instructions: Start playing a video or sound so you can test.
Find the Volume up key on the top row of keys. It looks like a speaker with sound waves.
Press it a few times. This also turns off mute.
steps.question: Can you hear sound now?

steps.title: Check the volume in the app
instructions: Look for a speaker or volume button inside the video or app.
Make sure it is not muted and is turned up.
steps.question: Can you hear sound now?

steps.title: Check if the website is muted
instructions: Look at the browser tab for the website.
A speaker with a line through it on the tab means the website is muted.
If you see it, right-click the tab and click Unmute site.
steps.question: Can you hear sound now?

steps.title: Test without headphones
instructions: If headphones are plugged in, unplug them.
If you use Bluetooth headphones, turn them off.
Listen for sound from the Chromebook's speakers.
If you don't use headphones, answer No.
steps.question: Can you hear sound from the speakers now?

steps.title: Reconnect your headphones
instructions: Your speakers work, so the problem is with the headphones.
Plug wired headphones back in firmly, all the way.
For Bluetooth headphones, turn them back on and wait for them to connect.
steps.question: Do your headphones work now?

steps.title: Turn it off and on again
instructions: Press and hold the power button until the screen goes dark.
Wait 10 seconds, then press the power button once to turn it back on.
Sign in and play a video or sound to test.
steps.question: Can you hear sound now?
